focused-final.xml.classification: Stable 32-case focal run before the additional late-renewal recovery fix; superseded by final regression for overlapping identities.

late-renewal-initial.xml.classification: Exact replay of a live renewal already issued was incorrectly denied when its previous lease expired. Initial issue and expired/revoked renewal denials passed.

late-renewal-final.xml.classification: Four directed cases passed after exact committed-renewal recovery was preserved.

regression-final.xml.classification: Historical filename retained: stable-source regression yielded 245 passed and two old fake-owner fixture failures (missing _lease_wake). Product use of that Event predates this milestone in commit d19d2f103.

renewal-fixture-final.xml.classification: Four parameters rerun after adding only the existing owner Event to the synthetic fixture. No product change.
